title: Input Validation and Sanitization
guideline_text: All user input must be validated and sanitized before processing to prevent injection attacks and ensure data integrity.

title: Account Lockout After Failed Attempts
guideline_text: User accounts should be temporarily locked after multiple consecutive failed login attempts to prevent brute force attacks.

title: Password Complexity Requirements
guideline_text: Password policies should enforce minimum complexity including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.

title: Encrypted Data Transmission
guideline_text: Sensitive data must be transmitted using encrypted channels such as HTTPS to protect against eavesdropping.

title: Secure Session Management
guideline_text: Session tokens should be securely generated, stored, and invalidated upon logout to prevent session hijacking.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
guideline_text: Critical systems should implement multi-factor authentication combining password with additional verification methods.

title: Single Sign-On Integration
guideline_text: Enterprise applications should support single sign-on for seamless user experience across multiple systems.

title: Password Reset Security
guideline_text: Password reset mechanisms must verify user identity through secure channels before allowing password changes.

title: Authentication Timeout
guideline_text: User sessions should automatically timeout after periods of inactivity to protect against unauthorized access.

title: Role-Based Access Control
guideline_text: System access permissions should be managed through role-based access control with principle of least privilege.

title: Authorization Checks
guideline_text: All resource access operations must include authorization checks to ensure users have appropriate permissions.

title: Response Time Requirements
guideline_text: System response times should meet specified thresholds for user operations to ensure acceptable performance.

title: Database Query Optimization
guideline_text: Database queries should be optimized using appropriate indexes and query patterns to minimize response latency.

title: Caching Strategy
guideline_text: Frequently accessed data should be cached to reduce database load and improve system responsiveness.

title: Concurrent User Support
guideline_text: System should support specified number of concurrent users without degradation in response times.

title: Resource Utilization Limits
guideline_text: Application should maintain CPU and memory usage within acceptable thresholds under normal load.

title: System Uptime Requirements
guideline_text: System availability should meet specified uptime percentage during operational hours.

title: High Availability Architecture
guideline_text: Critical systems should implement redundant components to ensure continued operation during failures.

title: Disaster Recovery Plan
guideline_text: Systems should have documented disaster recovery procedures with regular testing and backups.

title: Graceful Degradation
guideline_text: System should provide reduced functionality during partial failures rather than complete unavailability.

title: User Interface Intuitiveness
guideline_text: User interface should be intuitive and self-explanatory for new users without extensive training.

title: Error Message Clarity
guideline_text: Error messages should provide clear, actionable guidance for users to resolve issues.

title: Accessibility Standards
guideline_text: User interface should comply with accessibility standards to support users with disabilities.

title: Consistent Navigation
guideline_text: Navigation patterns should be consistent across all application screens for predictable user experience.

title: Horizontal Scalability
guideline_text: System architecture should support horizontal scaling by adding more servers to handle increased load.

title: Database Scaling Strategy
guideline_text: Database design should support scaling through partitioning, sharding, or read replicas as needed.

title: Load Balancing Implementation
guideline_text: Web applications should implement load balancing to distribute requests across multiple servers.

title: Elastic Resource Allocation
guideline_text: System should automatically adjust resources based on demand to optimize performance and cost.

title: Fault Detection Mechanisms
guideline_text: System should implement monitoring and detection mechanisms for component failures.

title: Automatic Failover
guideline_text: Critical components should support automatic failover to backup systems upon failure detection.

title: Data Consistency Checks
guideline_text: System should perform regular data consistency checks to detect and correct data corruption.

title: Circuit Breaker Pattern
guideline_text: External service calls should implement circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascade failures.

title: Code Documentation Standards
guideline_text: Source code should include comprehensive documentation explaining purpose, usage, and dependencies.

title: Modular Architecture
guideline_text: Application should follow modular design principles to enable independent development and testing.

title: Automated Testing Coverage
guideline_text: Code changes should be supported by automated tests with minimum coverage thresholds.

title: Version Control Practices
guideline_text: All code changes should be tracked in version control with meaningful commit messages.

title: Technical Debt Management
guideline_text: Technical debt should be tracked and addressed regularly to prevent system degradation.

title: Data Privacy Compliance
guideline_text: System must comply with data privacy regulations such as GDPR for handling personal information.

title: Audit Logging Requirements
guideline_text: All security-related events should be logged with timestamps for audit and compliance purposes.

title: Data Retention Policies
guideline_text: Data should be retained only for specified periods according to legal and business requirements.

title: Regulatory Standards Adherence
guideline_text: System development should adhere to relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements.
